d: Jordan and his followers annex a run-down part of Seattle, dubbing it "Promise City". Shawn's campaign for city council is threatened when a woman accuses him of using his healing ability in exchange for sex.

Jericho se apronta para uma visita muito especial do novo governo Cheyenne. Hawkings e Chaves trabalham para descobrir os segredos dos novos líderes.
O vírus mortal de Hudson River chega e a vacina está sendo retida dos cidadãos por um oficial do governo. Jake e os guardas encontram uma forma de proteger Jericho.
Hawkings recebe uma ligação de alguém que sabe quem ele é, onde ele está e avisa quando ele será pego. Enquanto isso, uma tragédia acontece.

A high school student develops an ability after injecting promicin. Tom visits Isabelle in jail, while Diana searches for her missing sister. Following the advice of a young woman named Cassie, Kyle is able to wake Shawn from his coma.

Tom and Diana search for a person who has the ability to make people's worst fears come to life. Danny seeks Shawn's help in finding a promicin shot. Cassie leads Kyle to a book that contains a prophecy about Jordan Collier.

d: Audrey Parker develops the ability to astral project herself. However, after she is murdered, Audrey attempts to use her ability to lead Tom and Diana to her killer.

After realizing Tom knows he is promicin-positive, Kyle joins Jordan in a remote town called Evanston. Tom follows Kyle, and learns the remarkable truth about Evanston: all of its residents are promicin-positive.
